cases.purpose: Verify named POSIX shared memory creation, mode and owner, exclusive collision preservation, invalid names and owned unlink independently of util-linux output.
cases.comparison: Explicit contract and independent kernel metadata; VM must provide a private empty /dev/shm. Creation and cleanup occur only in the disposable VM.

files.inner.sh:
# Run only in a disposable VM with a private, empty /dev/shm and uid 2000.
export LC_ALL=C
set -u
name=/t114-ipcmk-shm
path=/dev/shm/${name#/}
owned=0
cleanup() {
    if (( owned )); then
        /usr/bin/python3 observer.py unlink "$name" || echo 'cleanup failed' >&2
    fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT
[[ $(/usr/bin/id -u) == 2000 && ! -e $path ]] || { echo 'fixture prerequisite failed' >&2; exit 98; }
[[ $(type -t ipcmk) == builtin ]] || { echo 'ipcmk builtin missing' >&2; exit 98; }
umask 027
ipcmk -m 8192 -p 0666 --name "$name" >create.out 2>create.err
s=$?
if (( s == 0 )); then owned=1; fi
[[ $s == 0 && $(<create.out) == "Shared memory name: $name" && ! -s create.err ]] || { echo 'create failed' >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/python3 observer.py check "$name" initial || exit 1
ipcmk -m 4096 -p 0600 --name "$name" >collision.out 2>collision.err
s=$?
[[ $s == 1 && ! -s collision.out ]] || { echo 'collision status/output wrong' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ $(<collision.err) == "ipcmk: POSIX IPC creation failed for $name: File exists" ]] || { echo 'collision diagnostic wrong' >&2; exit 1; }
/usr/bin/python3 observer.py check "$name" retained || exit 1
for invalid in t114-ipcmk-invalid /t114-ipcmk-invalid/x /; do
    ipcmk -m 10 --name "$invalid" >invalid.out 2>invalid.err
    s=$?
    [[ $s == 1 && ! -s invalid.out && -s invalid.err && ! -e /dev/shm/t114-ipcmk-invalid ]] || { echo "invalid name accepted: $invalid" >&2; exit 1; }
done
/usr/bin/python3 observer.py unlink "$name" || exit 1
owned=0
[[ ! -e $path ]] || { echo 'object remains' >&2; exit 1; }
printf 'POSIX shared memory contract verified\n'
files.observer.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Independent kernel metadata and unlink observer; run only in a disposable VM.
import ctypes
import os
import stat
import sys

command, name = sys.argv[1:3]
if command == 'unlink':
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    if libc.shm_unlink(name.encode()) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'shm_unlink')
elif command == 'check':
    path = '/dev/shm/' + name[1:]
    info = os.stat(path)
    assert (info.st_size, stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode), info.st_uid) == (8192, 0o640, 2000), (info.st_size, oct(stat.S_IMODE(info.st_mode)), info.st_uid)
    if sys.argv[3] == 'initial':
        with open(path, 'r+b') as f:
            f.write(b't114 sentinel')
        with open('inode.txt', 'w') as f:
            f.write(str(info.st_ino))
    else:
        with open('inode.txt') as f:
            assert info.st_ino == int(f.read())
        with open(path, 'rb') as f:
            assert f.read(13) == b't114 sentinel'
else:
    raise ValueError(command)

cases.setup_script: /usr/bin/unshare --user --map-user=2000 --map-group=2000 --ipc /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c '[[ $(/usr/bin/id -u) == 2000 && -d /dev/shm && -w /dev/shm ]]' || { echo 'CONTROL-FAILED uid 2000 and writable private shm required'; exit 98; }
cases.oracle: Explicit assigned POSIX shared-memory contract and Linux metadata; no util-linux parity assumption.
